segments.ja440:1.1: Kaṇho vatāyaṃ puriso, kaṇhaṃ bhuñjati bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja440:1.3: Kaṇhe bhūmipadesasmiṃ, na mayhaṃ manaso piyo.
segments.ja440:2.1: Na kaṇho tacasā hoti, antosāro hi brāhmaṇo;
segments.ja440:2.3: Yasmiṃ pāpāni kammāni, sa ve kaṇho sujampati.
segments.ja440:3.3: Varaṃ brāhmaṇa te dammi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja440:5.1: Kiṃ nu kodhe vā [kodheva (sī. pī.)] dose vā, lobhe snehe ca brāhmaṇa;
segments.ja440:5.3: Ādīnavaṃ tvaṃ passasi [sampassasi (sī. pī.)], taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja440:6.1: Appo hutvā bahu hoti, vaḍḍhate so akhantijo;
segments.ja440:6.3: Āsaṅgī bahupāyāso, tasmā kodhaṃ na rocaye.
segments.ja440:7.1: Duṭṭhassa pharusā [paṭhamā (pī. sī. niyya)] vācā, parāmāso anantarā;
segments.ja440:7.3: Tato pāṇi tato daṇḍo, satthassa paramā gati [parāmasati (ka.)];
segments.ja440:7.5: Doso kodhasamuṭṭhāno, tasmā dosaṃ na rocaye.
segments.ja440:8.1: Ālopasāhasākārā [sahasākārā (sī. syā. pī.)], nikatī vañcanāni ca;
segments.ja440:8.3: Dissanti lobhadhammesu, tasmā lobhaṃ na rocaye.
segments.ja440:9.1: Snehasaṅgathitā [saṅgadhitā (ka.), saṅgantitā (syā.)] ganthā, senti manomayā puthū;
segments.ja440:9.3: Te bhusaṃ upatāpenti, tasmā snehaṃ na rocaye.
segments.ja440:10.3: Varaṃ brāhmaṇa te dammi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja440:11.5: Ābādhā mā [na (syā. pī.)] uppajjeyyuṃ, antarāyakarā bhusā.
segments.ja440:12.3: Varaṃ brāhmaṇa te dammi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja440:13.3: Na mano vā sarīraṃ vā, maṃ-kate sakka kassaci;
segments.ja440:13.5: Kadāci upahaññetha, etaṃ sakka varaṃ vareti.
